info.name: async-microservices
info.description: Validation of the customer-service and account-service APIs. Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner or Newman) with both services up (docker compose up). Folders 1 to 4 follow the challenge use cases; identifications and account numbers get a random suffix per run so the collection can be run many times.

item.name: 6. Asynchronous flow: deleting a customer deactivates its accounts

request.description: The CUSTOMER_DELETED event travels through Kafka; this request polls until the account is inactive.

exec: pm.test("detail is \"Customer not found\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Customer not found"));

item.name: No new accounts for a deleted customer

exec: pm.test("detail is \"Customer is not active\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Customer is not active"));

item.name: No movements on an inactive account

exec: pm.test("detail is \"Account is not active\"", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Account is not active"));
